changed_lines.before: const number = label => Number(result.stdout.match(new RegExp('^# ' + label + ' (\\d+)$', 'm'))?.[1]);
changed_lines.after: const number = label => { const matches = [...result.stdout.matchAll(new RegExp('^(?:#|ℹ) ' + label + ' (\\d+)\\r?$', 'gm'))]; assert.equal(matches.length, 1, 'Missing or ambiguous Node test summary: ' + label); return Number(matches[0][1]); };

reason: The original Node commands exited successfully with 255 passed tests, but the default spec reporter uses an information symbol instead of TAP # prefixes. The original wrapper could not parse its summary. This new one-shot source accepts either exact prefix, requires one unambiguous numeric line for each required field and preserves every other source byte.
